question: What if Singapore leaves ASEAN?

sources.title: ASEAN Summit
sources.excerpt: The ASEAN Summit is the highest policy-making body in ASEAN

sources.publisher: Singapore Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry
sources.title: Free Trade Agreements (FTAs)
sources.excerpt: Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) are treaties which make trade and investment between 2 or more economies easier.

findings.statement: The ASEAN Summit is ASEAN’s highest policy-making body.
findings.excerpt: The ASEAN Summit is the highest policy-making body in ASEAN
limitations: This describes an institutional role; it does not establish a withdrawal procedure.

findings.statement: FTAs are treaties intended to make trade and investment between economies easier.
findings.excerpt: Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) are treaties which make trade and investment between 2 or more economies easier.
limitations: This definition does not establish what happens to any specific treaty after an ASEAN membership change.
